changelog:
Initial release of zk-bankir-monitor — a read-only API monitoring tool for ZK-Bankir sovereign banking treasury.

- Provides health checks for ZK-Bankir server status
- Enables multi-asset treasury balance queries (BTC/PUSD/Kraken)
- Tracks and lists decisions in a hash-chained, append-only audit ledger
- Supports integrity verification of decision ledger via on-server hash-chain check
- Offers operator console views and freemium alerting (premium: thresholds, webhook integration)
summary: Monitor a ZK-Bankir sovereign banking treasury via API — health checks, balance queries, decision ledger tracking, and hash-chain verification.
